senses.definition_en: A formal promise or assurance that certain conditions will be fulfilled.
senses.definition_ar: تعهد أو وعد رسمي بأن شروطاً معينة ستتحقق.
examples: There is no guarantee that it will work.

senses.definition_en: A written promise by a company to repair or replace a faulty product within a specified period.
senses.definition_ar: وثيقة ضمان تلتزم فيها الشركة بإصلاح منتج أو استبداله إذا ظهر به عيب.
examples: The watch has a two-year guarantee.
The watch has a two-year guarantee.
There is no guarantee that it will work.
candidate.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Guard' 'حارس'.. الضمان 'Guarantee' بيحرس حقك وفلوسك
